DaSiWa_MetadataConfig.name: DaSiWa_MetadataConfig
DaSiWa_MetadataConfig.description: DaSiWa Metadata Config: collects workflow metadata settings and optional auto-detection links into one compact config output for the image saver.

key.description: The label for the custom metadata field.

value.description: The text content for the custom metadata field.

extra_metadata.description: Link another metadata node to chain multiple custom fields.

DaSiWa_CreateExtraMetadata.name: DaSiWa_CreateExtraMetadata
DaSiWa_CreateExtraMetadata.description: DaSiWa Create Extra Metadata: creates or extends a custom metadata key/value bundle for the image saver.

model.description: Base model that will receive the active LoRA stack.

clip.description: CLIP/text encoder paired with the model; LoRA weights are applied when compatible.

stack_data.description: JSON-encoded LoRA slot data managed by the custom UI. Each slot stores on/off, LoRA file, master strength, video multiplier, and audio multiplier.

model_type.description: Basic loads all LoRA tensors universally; LTX-2.3 enables video/audio separation.

use_cache.description: Activate caching of the loaded LoRA file + metadata. Off by default; when on, each unique LoRA file is read once instead of once per slot.

available_loras.description: Internal list of LoRA files used by the custom slot picker.

DaSiWa_LTX2LoraLoader.name: DaSiWa_LTX2LoraLoader
DaSiWa_LTX2LoraLoader.description: Advanced LoRA Loader: stacks ordinary image/video LoRAs or LTX-2.3 video/audio LoRAs. Audio separation is available only for LTX-2.3.

watermark_path.description: Select the watermark file (PNG recommended for transparency).

position.description: Static placement, or starting placement when randomize_position is enabled.

scale.description: Size relative to image width (0.2 = 20% width).

resampling.description: Scaling filter used when resizing the watermark. Bicubic is smooth; nearest keeps hard pixel edges.

padding_x.description: Horizontal inset from the selected edge, in pixels.

padding_y.description: Vertical inset from the selected edge, in pixels.

optical_padding.description: Adjust placement by the watermark's visual center (useful for wide/rotated marks).

optical_strength.description: Strength of optical-padding correction. 0 disables correction; 1 applies the full visual-center offset.

random_switches.description: Number of times to switch position when randomize_position is enabled.

fade.description: Enable fade in at start and end.

fade_margin.description: Fade duration as a percentage of total frames (0.1 = 10%).

randomize_position.description: Cycle through corner positions, starting at the selected position.

random_seed.description: 0 derives a stable seed from the watermark file name.

DaSiWa_Watermark.name: DaSiWa_Watermark
DaSiWa_Watermark.description:
DaSiWa Watermark: A professional-grade watermark overlay node with stable CPU compositing.
Stores output batches in RAM and blends from initialized source frames to avoid flicker,
Bicubic/Lanczos scaling, rotation, and 'Optical Padding' for perfect visual alignment.

text.description: Text input. Each {A|B|C} group is replaced with one random option.

DaSiWa_RandomStringPicker.name: DaSiWa_RandomStringPicker
DaSiWa_RandomStringPicker.description: DaSiWa Random String Picker: passes text through while replacing each {A|B|C} group with one randomly selected option.

seed_value.tooltip: Local seed value. The panel edits this; leave the native widget hidden.

seed_control_state.tooltip: Persisted seed-control state (JSON): mode, last_seed and recent seeds.

seed.tooltip: Optional external seed. When linked, the local controls are disabled and this value is passed through.

DaSiWa_SeedControl.name: DaSiWa_SeedControl
DaSiWa_SeedControl.description: Seed Control: the Director's seed panel as a standalone node — Random/Fixed mode, unsigned 64-bit seed, New roll, Use Last, last-10 history, an external seed override socket, and a NOISE output for downstream samplers.

DaSiWa_WildcardPresetPromptBuilder.name: DaSiWa_WildcardPresetPromptBuilder
DaSiWa_WildcardPresetPromptBuilder.description: Builds positive and negative prompts from the bundled dual-style wildcard library. Selections and weights are stored in the workflow.

model.description: Local model under ComfyUI/models/llm, or a cached 'Ollama:' / 'Server:' choice that sets its backend automatically. Uses saved DaSiWa LLM server settings automatically in single-user mode; service environment values take priority. Discovery runs in the background; press R afterwards.

custom_path.description: Optional absolute path, or relative path under ComfyUI/models/llm. Overrides model when set.

backend.description: Transformers loads local model folders; llama.cpp loads local GGUFs; ollama is legacy loopback. openai/ollama_server use operator-configured endpoints.

task.description: Use vision when analyzing connected images/frame batches.

dtype.description: Model dtype. Auto follows the model config when possible.

quantization.description: Optional bitsandbytes quantization. Requires bitsandbytes installed.

cache_mode.description: Cached is faster. Unload after run frees RAM/VRAM after every output.

kv_cache_implementation.description: Transformers KV-cache strategy. Quantized reduces generation memory but requires a compatible Transformers cache backend.

kv_cache_quant_backend.description: Backend used only by the quantized Transformers KV cache.

kv_cache_nbits.description: Bit width used only by the quantized Transformers KV cache.

kv_cache_residual_length.description: Recent KV tokens retained at full precision before older tokens are quantized.

llama_n_ctx.description: llama.cpp context size for a local GGUF model.

llama_n_gpu_layers.description: llama.cpp layers offloaded to GPU. -1 requests full offload; 0 is CPU-only.

llama_n_threads.description: llama.cpp CPU threads. 0 lets llama.cpp choose.

llama_chat_format.description: Optional llama.cpp chat format, for example chatml. Leave empty to use GGUF metadata.

ollama_model.description: Ollama model name, for example qwen3:8b. Required when backend is ollama.

server_model.description: Model ID on the operator-configured OpenAI-compatible or Ollama server.

DaSiWa_LLMModelSelector.name: DaSiWa_LLMModelSelector
DaSiWa_LLMModelSelector.description: DaSiWa LLM Model Selector: choose a local model from ComfyUI/models/llm or an operator-configured server, and configure inference and caching.

llm_config.description: Config from DaSiWa LLM Model Selector.

system_prompt_preset.description: Preset system instruction. Custom uses the system_prompt widget.

system_prompt.default: You are a concise, helpful visual and text analysis assistant.
system_prompt.description: Custom system prompt used only when system_prompt_preset is custom.

prompt.default: Follow the selected system instruction for the connected text, image, or video input.

max_input_tokens.description: Optional prompt/context token limit. 0 lets the tokenizer/model decide.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling value when temperature is above 0.

use_kv_cache.description: Keeps attention key/value cache during generation. Faster on, lower peak memory off for some models.

seed.description: -1 leaves the current RNG state untouched.

max_frames.description: Maximum images/frames sent to the VLM. 0 ignores connected images.

frame_stride.description: Stride used by the every_nth frame strategy.

frame_strategy.description: How to sample image batches from Load Image or VHS nodes.

resize_max_px.description: Downscale frames so the longest side is at most this many pixels. 0 disables resizing.

resize_algorithm.description: Resampling filter used when resize_max_px downscales images.

memory_cleanup.description: Optionally clear cached DaSiWa LLM models before and/or after this node runs.

images.description: Native ComfyUI IMAGE input. Works with Load Image and VHS/image-sequence frame batches.

h3_mode.description: Mode for the PromptForge H3 preset; REF2VA uses the Director.

h3_duration.description: Clip duration for the PromptForge H3 preset.

DaSiWa_LLMAnalyze.name: DaSiWa_LLMAnalyze
DaSiWa_LLMAnalyze.description: DaSiWa LLM Analyze: run a local or external text/vision model against connected text, images or video frame batches, with model-aware prompt rewriting.

model.description: Models in ComfyUI/models/llm plus cached Ollama and OpenAI-compatible server models. Uses saved DaSiWa LLM server settings automatically in single-user mode; service environment values take priority. Discovery runs in the background; press R afterwards. A vision model can read connected images.

write_for.description: The image, video or music target. YuE2 Song Style and Instrumental Style return Style text; YuE2 Lyrics returns section-tagged sung words. Connect separate writers to separate YuE2 fields.

start_with.placeholder: Quality tags and LoRA trigger words go here. Always first, exactly as typed.
start_with.description: Quality tags, LoRA trigger words or anything else that must lead the prompt. Put at the very top exactly as typed; the model never sees or changes it.

idea.description: Your visual or musical idea. For YuE2 include genre, voice, language, tempo and instruments for Style, or theme, language and supplied lines for Lyrics.

style.description: A visual look to carry through image/video prompts. Tag models get tags, prose models a description. Ignored for YuE2; describe the musical style in idea instead. None adds nothing.

detail.description: How much gets written. 5 is standard; lower is shorter, higher covers more.

creativity.description: How far past your idea the writer may go. 1 adds nothing, 5 is balanced, 10 builds well past it.

max_tokens.description: The most the model may write. Lower it to stop a model that runs on; set it too low and the prompt stops mid-sentence.

seed.description: Change it for a different take on the same idea.

keep_loaded.description: Off frees the memory after every prompt so the image model has it. On is faster for repeated prompts.

images.description: Optional reference pictures, one image or a batch, as on the Analyze node. Needs a vision model. Up to 8 are sent; a longer batch is sampled evenly from the first image to the last. For Wan and LTX the first image is the first frame.

DaSiWa_LLMPromptWriter.name: DaSiWa_LLMPromptWriter
DaSiWa_LLMPromptWriter.description: LLM Prompt Writer: type an idea, pick the image, video or music model it is for, and get a prompt written in that model's style. For every setting, use the Advanced LLM nodes.

images.description: Frames to encode as a video.

codec.description: Auto prefers browser-compatible 8-bit AV1/MP4 (faststart), then VP9/WebM and H.264/MP4 fallbacks. Choose H.265 explicitly when required.

container.description: Auto tries video containers only. Select Animated WebP or Animated AVIF manually; these image animations ignore codec selection and cannot include audio.

quality.description: Encoding quality for every encoder. 0 is no compression (largest files); higher values increase compression and reduce quality. 20 is the recommended default.

log_level.description: Legacy workflow compatibility; logging is always concise.

pingpong.description: Append the interior frames in reverse order for seamless forward/reverse playback.

save_metadata.description: Embed ComfyUI prompt and workflow metadata for workflow-aware video loaders.

filename_prefix.description: Output path/name prefix. Supports %seed%, %date%, and formatted dates such as video/%date:yyyy-MM-dd%/%date:hhmmss%. Connect the optional seed input to expand %seed%.

pass_frames.description: Return the encoded frame sequence for downstream processing.

crop_to_audio.description: When audio is connected, end the output video at the audio duration.

audio_codec.description: Audio codec. Auto uses Opus for WebM and AAC for MKV/MP4.

audio_bitrate.description: Target bitrate for the connected audio stream.

save_first_frame.description: Write the first frame as a PNG beside the encoded video.

save_last_frame.description: Write the last frame as a PNG beside the encoded video.

audio.description: Optional ComfyUI audio to mux into the encoded video.

seed.description: Optional generation seed used to expand %seed% in filename_prefix.

free_memory_if_needed.tooltip: Under RAM pressure, request native ComfyUI cache and pinned-memory release before encoding and at most every 5 seconds. May evict reusable caches. Never globally unloads GPU models or frees live IMAGE inputs; cannot guarantee swap-free encoding.

DaSiWa_EnhancedVideoCombine.name: DaSiWa_EnhancedVideoCombine
DaSiWa_EnhancedVideoCombine.description: Combines an IMAGE batch into a high-quality video with automatic NVENC/GPU selection, optional ping-pong playback, ComfyUI workflow metadata, and MP4 fallback.

model_name.tooltip: RIFE / FILM only: native safetensors in models/frame_interpolation. Ignored for RTX Frame Generation.

exact_endpoint.tooltip: Copy the first frame to the end: exact pixels, but one duplicate frame on repeat. Disable for continuous playback.

interpolation_backend.tooltip: RIFE / FILM: native checkpoint interpolation (default). RTX Frame Generation: NVIDIA VFX pair interpolation without a RIFE/FILM checkpoint; requires a supported NVIDIA GPU and SDK. Both morph only the loop transition, not the whole video's frame rate.

rtx_mode.tooltip: RTX only: LOW favors speed, MEDIUM is the middle tier, HIGH favors quality. Ignored for RIFE / FILM.

rtx_device_id.tooltip: RTX only: CUDA device index, 0 is the first GPU. Ignored for RIFE / FILM. Output still follows ComfyUI's intermediate-device policy.

DaSiWa_SeamlessLoop.name: DaSiWa_SeamlessLoop
DaSiWa_SeamlessLoop.description: Automatically selects and morphs a circular overlap. Arbitrary footage cannot be guaranteed artifact-free.

duration.tooltip: Seconds for a new take, or newly added seconds when Continuity is active (up to 15). Native H3 timing is rounded to its frame grid.

timeline_data.tooltip: Selected Director snapshot, including disabled/hidden references.

request_id.tooltip: Unique export request ID to prevent cached button results.

name.tooltip: Safe basename without paths; empty generates a unique director name. Never overwrites.

description.tooltip: Descriptive bundle metadata, not a training instruction.

concept_type.tooltip: Metadata label: general, identity, style, motion, or audio; does not alter encoding.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE, required for raw images/video.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE, required for raw audio or selected video sound.

sampled.tooltip: Source-resolution H3 sampler output; hidden sampled overlap is discarded, not rendered.

context.tooltip: This sampler’s Director Guide continuity_context. Works in both Director output modes: Full timeline behaves like Append & Stage, New segment only renders the bounded segment.

latent.tooltip: Segment Prepare.render_latent, optionally spatially upscaled; do not connect the raw sampler or stored delta.

vae.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 video VAE. Other temporal layouts are rejected.

audio_vae.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 32 kHz audio VAE. In New segment only, audio is cropped at cumulative sample boundaries without whole-clip loudness normalization; Full timeline decodes exactly like VAE Decode Audio.

context.tooltip: The matching Segment Prepare.segment_context; retain it unchanged through optional Upscale.

assembly_data.tooltip: Ordered uploaded media or checkpoint chain JSON. No AI repair. Matching 24-fps SDR canvases only; video/audio are re-encoded.

filename_prefix.tooltip: New unique MP4 in ComfyUI output; 1–80 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens. Existing files are never replaced.

vae.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 video VAE; encodes both edge clips as guides.

guide.tooltip: Director settings: mode, canvas and references. Its prompt and Continuity are replaced for the transition.

transition_data.tooltip: Set by Director → Join clips. Two uploaded clips, context frames per side, bridge length and optional description.

audio_vae.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 audio VAE; encodes both edge soundtracks as guides.

latent.tooltip: Sampler output for the Transition Guide window.

vae.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 video VAE.

audio_vae.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 32 kHz audio VAE.

transition.tooltip: Transition Guide plan for this window.

MiniMaxH3Cache.name: MiniMaxH3Cache
MiniMaxH3Cache.description: Approximate whole-block-stack residual cache for MiniMax H3. Higher thresholds skip more work and may reduce fidelity.

memory_budget_mb.tooltip: 0: automatic device-memory estimate. Nonzero caps the planning budget; not a hard allocator limit.

upscale_precision.tooltip: Learned latent-upscaler compute precision only. Auto uses ComfyUI device/backend policy. Does not change the incoming diffusion model or VAE. Interpolation does not use this setting.

continuity_soft_refine.tooltip: Active Continuity only: smoothly introduce video refinement over the source-tail overlap. Not RGB color matching.

continuity_mask_strength.tooltip: 0: original hard mask. 1: full smoothstep ramp over the existing Continuity overlap. Ignored unless soft refine is enabled and Continuity is active.

spatial_tiling.tooltip: Allow automatic spatial tiling for diffusion. A single full-canvas tile uses native sampling without a tiled wrapper. Off always uses the full canvas. Independent of memory-budget enforcement.

temporal_chunking.tooltip: Allow automatic temporal windows for learned upscale and diffusion, up to 30 latent tokens per planned window. Short videos may use one window. Off processes the complete video. Independent of memory-budget enforcement.

spike_guard.tooltip: Optional correction for unusually strong local latent deviations introduced by learned upscaling, which may appear as blown-out or discolored patches after decoding. Compares the upscaled result with the source and gently corrects detected regions before diffusion refinement. Experimental and default off: may suppress real detail. Evaluated signature is specific to 3d_conv_v1; other checkpoints are not validated. Ignored for interpolation.

guard_sensitivity.tooltip: Detection threshold, not correction strength. Lower values detect more regions and increase the risk of correcting real detail; higher values target only stronger outliers. Default 4.3. Ignored when Spike Guard is off, interpolation is selected, or strength is 0.

guard_strength.tooltip: How strongly detected regions are corrected toward the source-consistent low-resolution signal, with soft edges. 0 leaves the latent unchanged and skips guard allocations; 1 applies the full correction. Does not control the detection threshold. Ignored when Spike Guard is off or interpolation is selected.

guard_mode.tooltip: burn_direction (default): detect outliers matching one known 24-channel latent artifact pattern. Direction means the sign of that channel pattern, not a direction in the image or a brightness threshold. both: also detect the opposite sign of the same pattern, not all artifact types; broader detection can correct legitimate detail. Ignored when Spike Guard is off, interpolation is selected, or strength is 0.

enforce_memory_budget.tooltip: On: enforce the estimated diffusion budget with the selected memory reserve. Off: skip estimated budget rejection; you are responsible for actual OOM risk. Spatial/temporal planning, ComfyUI memory management and host RAM/spike guard checks remain active.

memory_reserve_pct.tooltip: Workspace reserve after device and model reservations. Default 5% is aggressive, not a VRAM guarantee. 0% still enforces explicit estimated costs; 100% leaves no refinement budget. Ignored when Memory Planning is off.

DaSiWaH3TiledUpscale.name: DaSiWaH3TiledUpscale
DaSiWaH3TiledUpscale.description: Single-node H3 latent upscale and per-step Tiled Diffusion. Automatic conservative tile/temporal planning; optional Director guide + video VAE re-encode endpoint images. Audio is preserved. No bbaudio dependency; no downstream widget introspection.

model.tooltip: Image diffusion model to patch; use the native checkpoint resolution as tile size.

tile_width.tooltip: Tile width in pixels (multiple of the model's latent scale, usually 8).

tile_height.tooltip: Tile height in pixels (multiple of the model's latent scale, usually 8).

overlap.tooltip: Overlap between neighbouring tiles in pixels; 64 or more hides seams.

DaSiWaTiledDiffusion.name: DaSiWaTiledDiffusion
DaSiWaTiledDiffusion.description: Patches a MODEL so every sampling step denoises overlapping image tiles and blends them, letting any image model sample canvases far larger than its native size.

mods.tooltip: A RefMod Stack. The editor shows its labels, and the bundle passes through to the 'mods' output for RefMod Text Encode.

MiniMaxH3PromptBuilder.name: MiniMaxH3PromptBuilder
MiniMaxH3PromptBuilder.description: Guided prompt builder for MiniMax H3 (T2VA / I2VA / FL2VA / L2VA / full-reference). Click 'Edit prompt' on the node to open the editor. Outputs the final prompt STRING plus a pass-through for every reference slot, so media can carry on to MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo. Each media output prefers its own input, falling back to the matching item from a connected Media Loader 'references' bundle. A RefMod Stack wired to 'mods' shows its labels in the editor and passes through to the 'mods' output for RefMod Text Encode.

MiniMaxH3MediaLoader.name: MiniMaxH3MediaLoader
MiniMaxH3MediaLoader.description: Load MiniMax H3 reference media by drag-and-drop or file picker. Wire 'references' to the Prompt Builder, and to the Reference Splitter when you also want individual slots for MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo. A video's soundtrack can be split off and paired with it automatically.

MiniMaxH3ReferenceSplitter.name: MiniMaxH3ReferenceSplitter
MiniMaxH3ReferenceSplitter.description: Split a MiniMax H3 references bundle into individual picture / video / video_audio / audio slots for MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.

folder.tooltip: Folder under ComfyUI's output directory. Use Browse… to pick one, or type a path.

subfolder.tooltip: Optional extra folders, e.g. 'Ref2V' or 'client/act2'. Created if missing.

date_folder.tooltip: Add a dated folder inside the one above, so each day's renders land together.

filename.tooltip: Start of the file name. The save node still appends its own counter.

MiniMaxH3FilenamePrefix.name: MiniMaxH3FilenamePrefix
MiniMaxH3FilenamePrefix.description: Builds a save prefix — folder / optional dated folder / filename — with the date already resolved, for save nodes that only expand date tokens typed directly into their widget.

mods.tooltip: Another stack or loader to append to. Its entries come first, so their labels keep their numbers.

MiniMaxH3RefModStack.name: MiniMaxH3RefModStack
MiniMaxH3RefModStack.description: Pick saved RefMods from a thumbnail library and send them as one bundle. Each pick has a weight per channel (look and voice): up to 1 is strength, above 1 adds copies. Wire 'mods' to Fantastic H3 RefMod Text Encode or Apply (or ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod's, which share the bundle type). 'labels' lists the <Picture n> / <Video n> / <Audio n> names Text Encode will assign. RefMod files are created with ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod.

width.tooltip: Generation width: sizes the empty latent and, with 'match', the media references.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps (124 = ~5 s). Media reference videos are cut to it.

ref_image_size.tooltip: Media pictures: 'match' scales each (down only) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' keeps up to a 2048 px short edge for identity, at a cost in speed. RefMods keep the size they were saved at.

reference_fps.tooltip: Playback rate assumed for a RefMod clip, to pick the frames H3's encoder is shown (two a second). Stacks use stack_pictures instead.

max_total_tokens.tooltip: Refuse RefMod bundles over this many reference tokens. 0 = no limit.

mods.tooltip: RefMod bundle from a RefMod Stack or the Prompt Builder's mods output.

references.tooltip: Media Loader bundle — from the loader, or the Prompt Builder's references output. Labelled before the RefMods.

vae.tooltip: H3 video VAE: encodes media pictures and clips, and reconstructs visual RefMods for the encoder. Not needed for audio-only references.

audio_vae.tooltip: H3 audio VAE: encodes media voices and soundtracks. RefMod voices are already encoded.

voice_description_at_label.tooltip: Your voice references are used either way; this only decides where their descriptions go. On: each voice RefMod's saved Voice description is also written right after its <Audio N>: label, where H3's encoder is introduced to the reference. A RefMod set to identity with a subject name leads with "It is <name>'s voice". Off: the bare label, exactly as core writes it.

stack_pictures.tooltip:
EXPERIMENTAL: How many pictures of a RefMod the text encoder sees (only RefMods made from several pictures; clips and single pictures aren't affected). More pictures may help lock in identity and reduce bleeding when using several RefMods, but increase memory use and generation time.

• every 4th (default): the first picture and every 4th after it. Fewest tokens; good for a single RefMod.
• up to N: N pictures spread across the stack (set N in stack_pictures_n). Costs more, possibly better identity retention.
• all: every picture. The most expensive, and can greatly increase generation time, but early tests suggest it helps with bleed between similar-looking characters.

stack_pictures_n.tooltip: How many pictures 'up to N' shows the text encoder, spread evenly across the stack. Only used when stack_pictures is 'up to N'.

MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModTextEncode.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModTextEncode
MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModTextEncode.description: Encode the prompt with references presented to H3's native encoder, so <Picture n>, <Video n> and <Audio n> in the prompt name them: Media Loader media from 'references' first, then the RefMod bundle, each kind counted in one sequence. Stands in for MiniMax H3 Reference to Video: its conditioning already carries the references (do not Apply the same bundle again) and 'latent' is the empty AV latent for the sampler. Needs the H3 video VAE for pictures and the audio VAE for voices.

retention.tooltip: Master multiplier on every entry's strength. 1 = as picked.

max_total_tokens.tooltip: Refuse bundles over this many reference tokens. 0 = no limit.

MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModApply.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModApply
MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModApply.description: Append the bundle's references to existing H3 conditioning. The prompt cannot name them this way; use Text Encode for <Picture n> labels. 'retention' multiplies every entry's strength.

mods.tooltip: The RefMod bundle the Text Encode gets.

references.tooltip: The Media Loader bundle the Text Encode gets.

MiniMaxH3FantasticReferenceMap.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticReferenceMap
MiniMaxH3FantasticReferenceMap.description: The Text Encode's reference_map without the encode: every reference's label in the order the model reads them, the media first and the RefMods numbered on from them. Wire it the same references and mods as the Text Encode. It shows the map as you edit the graph, with a Copy button for pasting it into an LLM, and outputs it for an LLM node writing the prompt.

name.tooltip: File name. A look plus a voice is saved as <name>_visual and <name>_audio.

mode.tooltip: Full keeps the most detail and is heavier to use. Compressed keeps the overall look and is much lighter.

ref_resolution.tooltip: Short edge each source is scaled down to before encoding (never up).

grid.tooltip: Compressed: size of the small grid on its long edge. 16 is up to 64 tokens per frame.

latent_frames.tooltip: Clips: how many frames to take from the start of the clip (after its trim). H3 stores 2 frames for up to 17 and 5 more per 17 after that, so 22 stores 7, 39 stores 12, 56 stores 17; anything between is cut down to the last of those.

refinement_steps.tooltip: Compressed: how long the small grid is refined toward the full encode.

max_tokens.tooltip: Refuse to save a look over this many tokens. 0 = no limit.

audio_max_seconds.tooltip: Voice: seconds kept from the start of the joined audio.

write_preview.tooltip: Save the first frame as <name>.png beside the file for the library's thumbnail.

source.tooltip: Media Loader item, or a list of them, as JSON. Filled by the RefMod library.

subject_name.tooltip: Optional one-word name used in prompts: the Prompt Builder's Draft from RefMods names the subject this, and !Name stands for it. Kept in the file's header.

appearance.tooltip: Optional: how the subject looks. Draft from RefMods writes it into the subject's definition line. Kept in the file's header.

voice_description.tooltip: Optional: how the voice sounds. Draft from RefMods adds it to the voice line, and the speaker buttons use it. Kept in the file's header.

retained_attributes.tooltip: Optional: specific small details that should be kept, such as tattoos or a scar. Draft from RefMods adds them to the end of the subject's retention note. Kept in the file's header.

image.tooltip: Look: one image, or a clip's frames at 24 fps. Replaces the source's pictures and clips.

audio.tooltip: Voice. Replaces the source's audio.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModCreate.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModCreate
MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModCreate.description: Encode pictures, clips or a voice into one RefMod and save it under models/refmods, with a preview image beside it. Several pictures or clips are stacked into a single RefMod, one frame each; the first one sets the frame size. 'source' is written by the RefMod library (one Media Loader item or a list); the image / audio inputs replace it for graph use. Over the token limit it refuses rather than dropping frames.

file.tooltip: RefMod file name under models/refmods, e.g. characters/hero_visual. Leave empty to use 'mods'.

view.tooltip: frames: each stored frame decoded on its own (photo stacks). video: decoded together as a clip.

strength.tooltip: Preview at this strength: below 1 shows the softening a lower weight applies.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE, for a look.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE, for a voice.

stored_blur.tooltip: Preview the Create tab's background blur on stored frames, as JSON {"masks": {frame index: {"mask", "strokes", "background", "grow"}}}. Only those frames are decoded.

MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModInspect.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModInspect
MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModInspect.description: Decode a RefMod back into pictures and sound to see what the model is given. Give it a file name (as the library does) or a bundle and an index. 'frames' shows each stored frame on its own — right for a stack of photos; 'video' plays them as a clip. Strength below 1 previews the softening a lower weight applies.

file.tooltip: The look's file under models/refmods, e.g. characters/hero_visual. May be a voice-only file when only the voice changes.

frames.tooltip: JSON list giving the new frame order: stored frame indices (0-based) and "a0", "a1"… for the items in 'add'. Empty = stored frames unchanged, additions appended.

add.tooltip: JSON list of Media Loader items (pictures/clips) to encode and add.

voice.tooltip: A Media Loader item (audio, or a clip with sound) to replace the voice; 'remove' to drop it; empty = unchanged.

latent_frames.tooltip: Frames taken from the start of an added clip; 22 stores 7 frames, 39 stores 12, 56 stores 17.

save_as.tooltip: Save the result as a new RefMod with this name (folders allowed, e.g. characters/hero_v2) and leave the original untouched. Empty = overwrite the original, except for a ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod bundle, which is always saved as a copy.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE, for added pictures.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE, for a new voice.

subject_name.tooltip: One-word name used in prompts, saved inside the file (the Prompt Builder's Draft from RefMods names the subject this). Empty keeps the stored name; '-' clears it.

appearance.tooltip: How the subject looks, drafted into their definition line. Empty keeps the stored text; '-' clears it.

voice_description.tooltip: How the voice sounds, drafted onto the voice line and the speaker buttons. Empty keeps the stored text; '-' clears it.

retained_attributes.tooltip: Specific small details that should be kept, drafted onto the end of the subject's retention note. Empty keeps the stored text; '-' clears it.

stored_blur.tooltip: Full RefMods: blur the background of stored frames, as JSON {"background": 0-1, "grow": pixels, "word": ..., "masks": {frame index: {"mask", "strokes", "background", "grow"}}}; the top-level values are Batch Masking's, for the record. The frames stay their size; background 0 blurs everything outside the subject.

MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModEdit.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModEdit
MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModEdit.description: Edit a saved RefMod: keep, drop or reorder its stored frames ('frames' is a JSON list of frame indices and "a<k>" entries in the new order), add pictures or clips encoded to the same shape ('add' is a JSON list of Media Loader items), replace or remove its voice, and set its subject name, appearance, voice description and retained attributes. Nothing already stored is re-encoded. Overwrites the file unless 'save_as' names a copy. Queued by the RefMod library's edit mode; the VAEs are only needed for additions.

files.tooltip: RefMod files under models/refmods, one per line, e.g. characters/hero_visual.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE.

MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModStoreFrames.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModStoreFrames
MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModStoreFrames.display_name: Fantastic H3 Store RefMod Encoder Frames
MiniMaxH3FantasticRefModStoreFrames.description: Add the frames H3's text encoder is shown to RefMods saved before they carried them, so the RefMod Text Encode reads them instead of decoding the RefMod. Each file is decoded once; its latent is not touched. Files that already have them and voice files are left alone. Queued by the RefMod library's Store encoder frames.

vae.tooltip: The H3 video VAE.

images.tooltip: The source clip's frames, at 24 fps.

mask.tooltip: White where the clip is regenerated: whatever is being replaced, changed or removed. One mask per frame, or a single frame for the whole clip.

grow.tooltip: Widen the mask by this many source pixels, so edges and shadows are replaced too.

keep_audio.tooltip: On: the source audio is held unchanged. Off, or no audio connected: the soundtrack is generated fresh.

audio_vae.tooltip: The H3 audio VAE, needed to keep the source audio.

audio.tooltip: The source clip's soundtrack.

megapixels.tooltip: Sample at no more than this many megapixels, keeping the clip's shape; never enlarged. 0 samples at the clip's own size.

MiniMaxH3FantasticVideoEditLatent.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticVideoEditLatent
MiniMaxH3FantasticVideoEditLatent.description: Turn a source clip and a mask into the latent MiniMax H3 samples for an edit: white areas of the mask are regenerated, everything else is held to the source. Use it in place of the empty latent, and wire width, height and length into the Text Encode. The Media Loader's Mask for editing does this for you through the RefMod Text Encode; this node is for masks made elsewhere.

images.tooltip: The decoded frames from VAE Decode.

references.tooltip: The Media Loader bundle, from the loader or the Prompt Builder's references output — the same one the Text Encode gets.

blend.tooltip: Extra soft edge, in output pixels, on top of the one the latent cells give.

max_size.tooltip: Cap the output's long edge. 0 keeps the source clip's size (after the loader's crop and size cap).

MiniMaxH3FantasticEditComposite.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticEditComposite
MiniMaxH3FantasticEditComposite.description: Put the edit back into the original footage: the area H3 regenerated (the mask, grown and rounded out to the latent's 16-pixel cells, feather included) is pasted into the Media Loader's clip through a soft edge, and everything else is the source file's own pixels, untouched by the VAE. Wire it between VAE Decode and Create Video, with the same references the Text Encode gets. With no clip being edited it passes the frames through.

model.tooltip: SAM 3.1, from Load Checkpoint.

clip.tooltip: SAM 3.1's text encoder, from the same Load Checkpoint.

video.tooltip: A Media Loader file, e.g. minimax_h3/clip.mp4 [input].

text.tooltip: What to find, e.g. phone. Commas for several.

points.tooltip: Clicked points as JSON: {"frames": [{"time": seconds, "positive": [{"x", "y"}], "negative": [...]}]}, x and y from 0 to 1 on the source frame.

start.tooltip: Trim start in seconds: only the kept span is masked.

end.tooltip: Trim end in seconds; 0 is the end of the clip.

mode.tooltip: What to do with the clip's current mask: replace it, add what's found to it, or take what's found out of it.

base.tooltip: The layer's current mask file, for add and subtract.

every_frame.tooltip: With dots and a name: also look for the name on every frame, and use what it finds wherever tracking lost the object (after a cut, say). Can pick up look-alikes.

subject.tooltip: For the RefMod Create tab: the mask goes to the cache, kept only until the RefMod is made, and finding nothing is reported instead of failing the run.

max_frames.tooltip: Frames masked from the trim start; 0 masks the whole trim.

pictures.tooltip: Pictures to find the subject in, instead of the clip, as JSON: [{"file", "rotate", "mirror", "positive", "negative"}], dots from 0 to 1 on the picture as turned and mirrored. With max_objects 1, only the largest match is kept.

MiniMaxH3FantasticObjectMask.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticObjectMask
MiniMaxH3FantasticObjectMask.description: Used by the Media Loader's Mask for editing panel: finds an object or person in a loaded clip with SAM 3.1 (core ComfyUI's SAM 3 nodes) and saves its mask beside the clip. The RefMod library's Create tab uses it too, to find the subject in each picture or clip. You don't need to place this node yourself.

model.tooltip: The H3 model, between its loader and the sampler.

cache.tooltip: references: RefMods and reference media. references and prompt: also the prompt and what the text encoder was shown, which can be as many tokens as the references; more speed, more approximation.

refresh_every.tooltip: Run the cached rows in full on the first model call and every this many after it. Higher is faster and drifts further from a normal run.

store_8bit.tooltip: Keep the cached rows as 8-bit floats with a scale per row: half the RAM and half the copying, with values typically 2-3% off between refreshes. Any GPU ComfyUI can store fp8 weights on; not Apple (MPS) or DirectML.

MiniMaxH3FantasticReferenceCache.name: MiniMaxH3FantasticReferenceCache
MiniMaxH3FantasticReferenceCache.description: EXPERIMENTAL. Speeds up H3 sampling with RefMods or reference media by reusing the reference rows between steps instead of running them through every block each step. Between refreshes the references don't see the video change, so results differ from a normal run. Bypass the node to compare.

model.tooltip: MiniMax H3 diffusion model used for every Continuum chunk.

clip.tooltip: MiniMax H3 text encoder used to encode the complete Sequence Prompt.

video_vae.tooltip: Used only to encode image conditioning. T2VA does not use it; Continuum never decodes with it.

sampler.tooltip: ComfyUI sampler algorithm used unchanged for every generated chunk.

sigmas.tooltip: ComfyUI noise schedule used unchanged for every generated chunk.

sequence_prompt.tooltip: Connect one Text (Multiline) for the complete sequence.

prompt_mode.tooltip: Auto accepts Fixed, list-separated, and timeline prompt styles.

chunks.tooltip: Number of sequential Continuum chunks to generate.

chunk_seconds.tooltip: Target duration shared by every chunk. 5–15 seconds is the recommended and validated range. Values above 15 seconds are supported, but VRAM use and processing time can increase substantially, especially at high resolution.

aspect.tooltip: Saved V3.8 workflow compatibility only. The frontend migrates this value to Size Source and hides it from the Main UI.

preset.tooltip: Used only with Size Source = First Image. Draft is fastest; Balanced retains more detail; Native 768 uses the H3 native short edge; Custom uses Custom MP.

custom_mp.tooltip: Custom target megapixels while preserving the connected First Image aspect ratio. Used only when Resolution Preset is Custom.

continuity.tooltip: Amount of prior video context retained at each chunk boundary.

base_seed.tooltip: Base seed used to derive deterministic per-chunk seeds.

audio_continuity.tooltip: On passes prior audio context into continuation chunks. Turn it off only to isolate or replace generated audio.

diagnostics.tooltip: Controls the detail level of the read-only Status report. It does not change generated tensors.

reroll_from_chunk.tooltip: Auto resumes the longest compatible saved prefix. Choosing a chunk reuses earlier chunks and regenerates that chunk and everything after it.

reroll_nonce.tooltip: Change only when regenerating an explicit chunk and you want a new variation with otherwise identical settings.

strict_compatibility.tooltip: Legacy saved-workflow input. V3.8 keeps it loadable but ignores its value.

debug.tooltip: Developer diagnostics controlled by the H3 Continuum settings panel.

show_preview.tooltip: Show live sampling previews. Disable only to reduce preview overhead.

run_storage.tooltip: Atomically save raw AV chunks and resume a compatible saved run.

run_name.tooltip: Enter a stable name for this saved run. Compatible chunks are selected automatically.

reference_size.tooltip: Match Output is the practical default; Max Identity preserves more reference detail.

project_id.tooltip: Optional. Leave blank to derive a stable ID from this sampler node. Run Name remains the explicit override.

video_reference_size.tooltip: Efficient limits Video Guide Frames to about 0.4 MP; Balanced uses about 0.6 MP; Match Output uses the output pixel area. Source aspect ratio is preserved and smaller sources are not enlarged.

continuation_backend.tooltip: Standard uses the V3.6 target-preserving continuation path. With Audio Continuity enabled, Masked AV currently uses Balanced 22; Fast 5, Strong 39, and Auto safely use Reference Context. Compatibility restores the V3.5 Reference Context path for older workflows or comparison. Run Storage identity follows the resolved transport before execution begins.

generation_mode.tooltip: Full Run preserves normal Production execution. Review Each Chunk generates at most one new physical group per Queue and requires Run Storage = Save + Auto Resume.

review_action.tooltip: Continue / Next accepts the current review and advances. Regenerate Current and Finish Remaining are one-shot actions. Smart Regenerate requires Regenerate From = Auto.

take_group.tooltip: Internal Render History selection. Use the visible Previous/Next Take controls instead of editing this value directly.

take_revision_id.tooltip: Immutable revision selected by Render History. The visible Take controls manage this value from verified Run Storage data.

take_action.tooltip: One-shot Render History action. Selecting a Take alone does not change the canonical branch; Queue normally after choosing an action.

size_source.tooltip: First Image preserves its aspect at the selected Resolution Preset. Manual uses Width and Height exactly. Legacy Aspect is accepted only for saved-workflow and API compatibility.

width.tooltip: Exact output width in Manual mode. Use a multiple of 32. Manual mode is the normal choice for T2VA or workflows without a First Image.

height.tooltip: Exact output height in Manual mode. Use a multiple of 32. Manual mode is the normal choice for T2VA or workflows without a First Image.

first_frame.tooltip: First Image conditioning for I2VA or FL2VA. With Output Size = First Image, its aspect ratio also defines the output canvas. Leave it disconnected and use Manual Width/Height for T2VA.

last_frame.tooltip: Optional last-frame anchor for FL2VA. Leave disconnected for T2VA and normal I2VA.

reference_image_1.tooltip: Optional Reference Image 1 for appearance, identity, subject, or scene guidance.

reference_image_2.tooltip: Optional Reference Image 2. Prompt references follow the connected image order.

reference_image_3.tooltip: Optional Reference Image 3. Prompt references follow the connected image order.

reference_video_1.tooltip: 24 fps IMAGE frames from the Video Adapter. Follow Timeline selects successive physical output intervals; Repeat Reference keeps the legacy shared-prefix guide. Source audio is not included. Follow is Experimental; this is not a hard motion-copy control.

driving_audio.tooltip: Optional original audio timeline. It is used as native H3 guide conditioning and selected unchanged for final output.

audio_vae.tooltip: Required only when Driving Audio is connected. Uses the same Audio VAE encode path as ComfyUI Core MiniMax H3 Add Guide.

reference_audio_1.tooltip: Optional standalone audio reference for H3 conditioning. It is not the audio track of Video Guide Frames. Unlike Driving Audio, it does not replace the generated final audio.

reference_audio_vae.tooltip: Required only when Reference Audio is connected. It encodes the reference for H3 conditioning; generated audio remains the output.

guide.tooltip: Optional V3.7 Still Image Guide. Only the owning physical sampling group receives the Core minimax_keyframes entry.

audio_references.tooltip: Optional ordered bundle from H3 Continuum Reference Audios. Do not connect it together with the legacy single Reference Audio input.

image_references.tooltip: Optional Reference Images 4–9 from H3 Continuum Reference Images. Existing slots 1–3 remain first.

video_reference_mode.tooltip: Experimental. Follow Timeline selects the source interval for each physical generation group, then continues without video reference after the source ends. Repeat Reference preserves the previous Video Guide behavior: the same bounded prefix for every group. This is independent of Prompt Format. Input frames must be 24 fps.

H3ContinuumSamplerV38.name: H3ContinuumSamplerV38
H3ContinuumSamplerV38.description: H3 Continuum V3.8 facade over the unchanged V3.7 Production engine. Size Source and preset resolve to the existing width/height runtime contract; post-generation reliability diagnostics inspect frame/audio grids, Core compatibility, and relative visual conditioning load without changing tensors.

reference_images.tooltip: Connect H3 Continuum Reference Images V3.9; assign chunks there.

H3ContinuumSamplerV39.name: H3ContinuumSamplerV39
H3ContinuumSamplerV39.description: H3 Continuum V3.9. Connect Reference Images V3.9 to assign fixed images 1–9 to all chunks or selected chunks.

reference_audio_1.tooltip: Optional standalone voice or sound reference. Connect inputs in order without gaps; their order maps to the matching <Audio N> prompt tags.

reference_audio_2.tooltip: Optional standalone voice or sound reference. Connect inputs in order without gaps; their order maps to the matching <Audio N> prompt tags.

reference_audio_3.tooltip: Optional standalone voice or sound reference. Connect inputs in order without gaps; their order maps to the matching <Audio N> prompt tags.

reference_audio_vae.tooltip: Shared Core Audio VAE used to encode every connected Reference Audio. Required when any audio is connected.

H3ContinuumReferenceAudios.name: H3ContinuumReferenceAudios
H3ContinuumReferenceAudios.description: Bundle up to three ordered standalone Reference Audios for the V3.8 sampler. Connected inputs map directly to <Audio 1>, <Audio 2>, and <Audio 3>; generated final audio is never replaced.

reference_image_4.tooltip: One optional appearance or identity image. Empty slots are skipped in prompt order.

reference_image_5.tooltip: One optional appearance or identity image. Empty slots are skipped in prompt order.

reference_image_6.tooltip: One optional appearance or identity image. Empty slots are skipped in prompt order.

reference_image_7.tooltip: One optional appearance or identity image. Empty slots are skipped in prompt order.

reference_image_8.tooltip: One optional appearance or identity image. Empty slots are skipped in prompt order.

reference_image_9.tooltip: One optional appearance or identity image. Empty slots are skipped in prompt order.

H3ContinuumReferenceImages.name: H3ContinuumReferenceImages
H3ContinuumReferenceImages.description: Bundle optional Reference Images 4–9 for the Continuum Sampler. Encoding remains in the Sampler.

reference_use.tooltip: All chunks uses connected images throughout. Per chunk uses the assignments below.

reference_r1_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 1; use the in-node table.

reference_r2_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 2; use the in-node table.

reference_r3_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 3; use the in-node table.

reference_r4_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 4; use the in-node table.

reference_r5_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 5; use the in-node table.

reference_r6_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 6; use the in-node table.

reference_r7_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 7; use the in-node table.

reference_r8_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 8; use the in-node table.

reference_r9_chunks.tooltip: Saved assignments for Reference Image 9; use the in-node table.

reference_image_1.tooltip: Fixed Image 1 / @R1. Its number never changes with other connections.

reference_image_2.tooltip: Fixed Image 2 / @R2. Its number never changes with other connections.

reference_image_3.tooltip: Fixed Image 3 / @R3. Its number never changes with other connections.
